name: Maou-sama no Konwaku
source:
The protagonist is a devil king, and yet there's nothing repellant about him.
He's smart, capable (one might say showy) and not at all gruff or evil toward anyone.
He keeps a tidy castle and enjoys playing baseball and things.

He also has a personal servant named Milly-chan.
Milly's been a devoted minion-maid for generations of devil kings.
She's begun to slip into darkness lately... the erotic kind. 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE159371.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是魔王，却一点也不令人害怕。
他聪明、能干（甚至可以说华丽），对任何人都不粗暴或邪恶。他把城堡打理得井井有条，还喜欢打棒球之类的活动。

他还有一位私人侍从米莉酱。米莉世世代代作为魔王的忠诚侍女，如今却逐渐陷入黑暗……色情的黑暗。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE159371.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
